title: Blog post header
description: The header of a blog post or article, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Avatar, Badge, Button and Skeleton primitives: a category Badge with the date and reading time, the post's title as a serif h1, a short excerpt, then a byline with the author's Avatar, name and role, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the excerpt steps up at @sm, the title steps up and everything centres at @md, and the header gets more room at @lg.
